segments.name: SHOP
segments.description: Owns senior housing communities operated by third-party managers, participating directly in the financial performance of the communities' operations for aging residents.
segments.evidence: We operate through three reportable segments: senior housing operating portfolio, which we refer to as "SHOP," outpatient medical and research portfolio, which we refer to as "OM&R," and triple-net leased properties, which we refer to as "NNN."

segments.name: OM&R
segments.description: Owns outpatient medical buildings and research centers serving health systems, physicians and research institutions in North America and the United Kingdom.
segments.evidence: We hold a portfolio that includes senior housing communities, outpatient medical buildings, research centers, hospitals and healthcare facilities located in North America and the United Kingdom.

segments.name: NNN
segments.description: Owns healthcare properties leased to tenants under triple-net leases, where tenants bear property operating costs.
segments.evidence: We operate through three reportable segments: senior housing operating portfolio, which we refer to as "SHOP," outpatient medical and research portfolio, which we refer to as "OM&R," and triple-net leased properties, which we refer to as "NNN."

revenueModel.text: Ventas earns resident fees for room, board and services at senior housing communities, rent from tenants of its medical, research and triple-net properties, and fees as general partner of third-party institutional investment vehicles.
revenueModel.evidence: Charges for room, board and services at these communities are generally paid from private sources, with limited reliance on government reimbursement programs such as Medicaid.
